calls.statement:
SELECT
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT
  sku,
  product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name LIKE '%Oulu Kaakkuri%'
  AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT DISTINCT
  sku,
  product_name,
  valid_from,
  valid_to,
  is_current
FROM dim_product
WHERE sku = 101624
ORDER BY valid_from DESC
